title: Good reasons for IDS
html:
Regardless of whether you are an exhibitor or visitor – there is no way around IDS. For many good reasons.

unrivalled leading global trade fair.

Due to its entirety and high number of innovations it impressively underlines its significance as a forward-looking trendsetter of the dental industry.

Very large product section

One doesn't find such a breadth and depth of dental products and services at any other trade fair in the world.

The main meeting point of the dental family

Offering manifold opportunities for encounters, IDS encourages the trade fair participants to establish new business contacts and intensify their existing friendships.

Valuable contacts

In this way, IDS offers all parties involved the best prerequisites to achieve their professional and business goals.
